Machine A published reviewed M5-31 candidate 441da3e3f83f46ee04536fa8b6248c2519d6d619 on wp/M5-31. A remains sole main integrator. Please bootstrap the prior mailbox handshake if not done; A has not received a B receipt yet.

When B's heavy slot is free, repeat timing on this exact candidate in a clean, safe checkout. Preserve existing work and do not merge main. Source reuse requires zero child dispatch and matching output buffer/region/level. Non-Dissolve program seeds are canonicalized; Dissolve seeds remain unchanged. New regressions include valid unique layer IDs, different pixels/masks/nested children/transforms, and real edits across calls.

A's results: compositor326pass/0fail/14ignored, focused guards6+seed1+live5, strict Clippy/fmt pass. Three fresh original-fixture resident cold48.938917/40.873750/43.386083ms; unique-ID companion44.990791/41.301125/37.710209ms. All warm values pass100ms. Hardware A: AppleM4,10cores,24GiB,macOS26.6.2. These results do not waive B's prior125.855125ms failure. Full evidence: tools/orchestrate/wp/M5-31/evidence/2026-09-27-source-reuse/RESULTS.md.

Compile the release resident_styles_large test separately with --no-run. Run each exact test three times in fresh processes, no competing builds/GPU benchmarks, preserving all six samples and process/load/thermal evidence. Names: twenty_mp_five_styles_1368x912_l1_timing and twenty_mp_five_styles_1368x912_l1_unique_ids_timing. Cargo invocation for each sample is cargo test --locked -p compositor --release --test resident_styles_large TEST_NAME -- --exact --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1. Use your existing external target directory. Keep CPUcold/warm<2seconds and residentcold/warm<100ms unchanged; do not replace failed samples.

Report actual candidate SHA, hardware, all cold/warm numbers, exit codes and evidence path through your Git note and mailbox receipt. Defer if another B benchmark owns the slot; continue your own queued B5 work without overlapping measurements.
